properties.name: Run cargo fmt --all BEFORE the export: a reformat after it changes artifact checksums and forces a second export and an amended commit
properties.statement: Measured on PR #490 (2026-09-12): the increment's Rust edits were never formatted; CI's Format gate was the only red; running `cargo fmt --all` then changed three source files whose checksums the design holds, which meant accepting three baselines, re-exporting, and amending — a full extra cycle for whitespace. The order that avoids it, for this repo's chain: build → tests → `cargo fmt --all && cargo fmt --all --check` → clippy → toolsnap/render/lint → graph record → checksums → export → gates with `rc=$?` captured → commit. The export is last relative to every file the design checksums, and formatting is a file change. Moved here from an agent's machine-local memory file (rule:a-rule-the-project-follows-lives-in-the-graph-not-in-an-agents-memory).
